name: After § 68
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: 68b. Calls on the anti-fraud services to investigate whether the legal weaknesses in the contracts above EUR 1 billion negotiated by the Commission are due to incompetence or mal-intent (for example: the EMA building in London; conditions not allowing the Member States to ‘get out’ of the Pfizer contract; companies not facing any consequences in the event of side effects; a massive variable-rate loan just before the rise in rates);
